1.w: Praise the Lord. Praise the Lord from the sky. Praise him in the heavens.

2.w: Praise him, all his angels. Praise him, all his heavenly assembly.

3.w: Praise him, O sun and moon. Praise him, all you shiny stars.

4.w: Praise him, O highest heaven and you waters above the sky.

5.w: Let them praise the name of the Lord, for he gave the command and they came into existence.

6.w: He established them so they would endure; he issued a decree that will not be revoked.

7.w: Praise the Lord from the earth, you sea creatures and all you ocean depths,

8.w: O fire and hail, snow and clouds, O stormy wind that carries out his orders,

9.w: you mountains and all you hills, you fruit trees and all you cedars,

10.w: you animals and all you cattle, you creeping things and birds,

11.w: you kings of the earth and all you nations, you princes and all you leaders on the earth,

12.w: you young men and young women, you elderly, along with you children.

13.w: Let them praise the name of the Lord, for his name alone is exalted; his majesty extends over the earth and sky.

14.w: He has made his people victorious and given all his loyal followers reason to praise— the Israelites, the people who are close to him. Praise the Lord!
